Setup wd, download libraries, read in log cpm file 

```{r}
setwd("/restricted/projectnb/crem-trainees/Murphy_Lab/Elise/GeroScreen_Paper")
 
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(limma)
})
 
out_dir <- "Fig1_exploratory"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
 
## Analysis settings
n_var_genes <- 500    # most variable genes used for PCA
fdr_cut     <- 0.05   # DEG threshold (BH-adjusted p)
lfc_cut     <- 0      # optional |log2FC| threshold for DEG counts (e.g. 0.5)
 
## Default sans font (Arial is not installed on the SCC)
base_font <- "sans"
use_ragg <- requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)
 
logcpm_raw <- read.csv("26_01_29_logcpm.csv", check.names = FALSE,
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 
annot_cols  <- c("gene_key", "gene_id", "symbol", "feature_name",
                 "Length", "gene_biotype")
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(logcpm_raw), annot_cols)
```

sample meta data 
```{r}
group_levels <- c("CTRL", "RUT", "SIT", "GEN", "EBS", "CAL", "PI", "TRA", "RAP")
full_names   <- c(CTRL = "Vehicle", RUT = "Rutin", SIT = "Sitagliptin",
                  GEN = "Genistein", EBS = "Ebselen", CAL = "Calpeptin",
                  PI = "PI-103", TRA = "Trametinib", RAP = "Rapamycin")
 
meta <- data.frame(sample = sample_cols, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(line  = factor(sub("_.*$", "", sample)),
         cond  = sub("^[^_]+_", "", sample),
         group = factor(sub("[0-9]+$", "", cond), levels = group_levels),
         rep   = sub("^.*?([0-9]+)$", "\\1", cond),
         label = factor(full_names[as.character(group)],
                        levels = full_names[group_levels]))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(meta$group)))
 
treatments <- setdiff(group_levels, "CTRL")
 
## Same colours as the pathway-score figure (Okabe-Ito, grey for vehicle)
group_cols <- setNames(c("grey55", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442",
                         "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "#000000"),
                       full_names[group_levels])
```

set up expression matrix 
```{r}
## Rows keyed by Ensembl ID so no genes are lost to duplicate symbols
expr <- as.matrix(logcpm_raw[, meta$sample])
rownames(expr) <- logcpm_raw$gene_id
symbol_lookup  <- setNames(logcpm_raw$symbol, logcpm_raw$gene_id)
```

set theme and spots to save 
```{r}
theme_fig <- theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = base_font) +
  theme(axis.text        = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.line        = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
        axis.ticks       = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.key.size  = unit(0.35, "cm"),
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
 
save_fig <- function(p, name, w, h) {
  if (use_ragg) {
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h,
           units = "in", dpi = 600, device = ragg::agg_png)
  } else {
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h,
           units = "in", dpi = 600)
  }
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), p, width = w, height = h,
         units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
}
```

Run PCA 
```{r}
run_pca <- function(mat, n_genes) {
  vars <- apply(mat, 1, var)
  top  <- names(sort(vars, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(n_genes, nrow(mat)))]
  pc   <- prcomp(t(mat[top, ]), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
  pve  <- 100 * pc$sdev^2 / sum(pc$sdev^2)
  list(scores = data.frame(pc$x[, 1:4], sample = rownames(pc$x)) %>%
         left_join(meta, by = "sample"),
       pve = pve)
}
 
pca_plot <- function(pca, title) {
  ggplot(pca$scores, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = label, shape = line)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = group_cols, name = "Treatment") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17), name = "Line") +
    labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", pca$pve[1]),
         y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", pca$pve[2]),
         title = title) +
    theme_fig
}

## 4a. Uncorrected — expected to separate mainly by line
pca_raw <- run_pca(expr, n_var_genes)
p_pca_raw <- pca_plot(pca_raw, "All samples")
save_fig(p_pca_raw, "Fig1A_PCA_uncorrected", 4.2, 3.2)

p_pca_raw
 
## 4b. Line effect removed (treatment effects preserved via the design)
expr_corr <- removeBatchEffect(expr, batch = meta$line,
                               design = model.matrix(~ group, data = meta))
pca_corr <- run_pca(expr_corr, n_var_genes)
p_pca_corr <- pca_plot(pca_corr, "Genetic background effect removed")
save_fig(p_pca_corr, "Fig1B_PCA_line_corrected", 4.2, 3.2)


```

DEGs treatment groups vs ctrl 

```{r}
## 5a. Pooled model: each treatment vs vehicle, blocked on line
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group + line, data = meta)
colnames(design) <- make.names(sub("^group", "", colnames(design)))
contr <- makeContrasts(contrasts = paste0(make.names(treatments), " - CTRL"),
                       levels = design)
colnames(contr) <- treatments
 
fit_lm <- lmFit(expr, design)
fit_c  <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit_lm, contr), trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)
 
de_pooled <- bind_rows(lapply(treatments, function(tx) {
  topTable(fit_c, coef = tx, number = Inf, sort.by = "none") %>%
    mutate(gene_id = rownames(.), symbol = symbol_lookup[gene_id],
           treatment = tx)
}))
write.csv(de_pooled, file.path(out_dir, "limma_pooled_vs_vehicle_all_genes.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
 
## 5b. Per-line model: each treatment vs vehicle within BU6 and within BU8
meta$line_group <- factor(paste(meta$line, meta$group, sep = "_"))
design_l <- model.matrix(~ 0 + line_group, data = meta)
colnames(design_l) <- sub("^line_group", "", colnames(design_l))
 
line_contrasts <- unlist(lapply(levels(meta$line), function(l)
  paste0(l, "_", treatments, " - ", l, "_CTRL")))
contr_l <- makeContrasts(contrasts = line_contrasts, levels = design_l)
colnames(contr_l) <- sub(" - .*$", "", line_contrasts)
 
fit_l <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(lmFit(expr, design_l), contr_l),
                trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)
lfc_by_line <- as.data.frame(fit_l$coefficients) %>%
  mutate(gene_id = rownames(.)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "contrast", values_to = "logFC") %>%
  separate(contrast, into = c("line", "treatment"), sep = "_") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = line, values_from = logFC)
```

DEG counts 

```{r}
deg_counts <- de_pooled %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cut, abs(logFC) > lfc_cut) %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Up", "Down")) %>%
  count(treatment, direction) %>%
  complete(treatment = treatments, direction = c("Up", "Down"),
           fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(full_names[treatment], levels = full_names[treatments]),
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Up", "Down")),
         n_signed = ifelse(direction == "Down", -n, n))
write.csv(deg_counts %>% select(treatment, direction, n),
          file.path(out_dir, "DEG_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
 
deg_lim <- max(abs(deg_counts$n_signed)) * 1.18
p_deg <- ggplot(deg_counts, aes(label, n_signed, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n, vjust = ifelse(direction == "Up", -0.4, 1.3)),
            size = 2.6, family = base_font) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Up = "#B2182B", Down = "#2166AC"), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = abs, limits = c(-deg_lim, deg_lim)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "DEGs vs vehicle",
       title = sprintf("Differentially expressed genes (FDR < %.2f)", fdr_cut)) +
  theme_fig +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_deg

save_fig(p_deg, "Fig1C_DEG_counts", 4.2, 3.2)
```

Cross line concordance 

```{r}
## Genes are SELECTED in one line and their effect is MEASURED in the other,
## so the correlation is not inflated by selecting on the pooled result.
## Main panel: top n_conc genes by BU6 p-value, plotted against BU8.
## The reverse direction (selected in BU8) is reported in the CSV.
n_conc <- 500
 
top_by_line <- function(sel_line) {
  bind_rows(lapply(treatments, function(tx) {
    topTable(fit_l, coef = paste0(sel_line, "_", tx), number = n_conc,
             sort.by = "P") %>%
      transmute(gene_id = rownames(.), treatment = tx)
  }))
}
 
conc_df <- top_by_line("BU6") %>%
  left_join(lfc_by_line, by = c("gene_id", "treatment")) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(full_names[treatment], levels = full_names[treatments]))
 
conc_rev <- top_by_line("BU8") %>%
  left_join(lfc_by_line, by = c("gene_id", "treatment")) %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(r_selected_in_BU8 = cor(BU6, BU8), .groups = "drop")
 
conc_r <- conc_df %>%
  group_by(treatment, label) %>%
  summarise(r = cor(BU6, BU8), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(txt = sprintf("r = %.2f", r))
 
write.csv(conc_r %>% select(treatment, r_selected_in_BU6 = r) %>%
            left_join(conc_rev, by = "treatment"),
          file.path(out_dir, "line_concordance_r.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
 
ax_lim <- quantile(abs(c(conc_df$BU6, conc_df$BU8)), 0.995)
p_conc <- ggplot(conc_df, aes(BU6, BU8)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
              colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = label), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = conc_r, aes(label = txt), x = -ax_lim, y = ax_lim,
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.3, lineheight = 0.9,
            family = base_font) +
  facet_wrap(~ label, nrow = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_cols, guide = "none") +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-ax_lim, ax_lim), ylim = c(-ax_lim, ax_lim)) +
  labs(x = expression(BU6~log[2]*FC~vs~vehicle),
       y = expression(BU8~log[2]*FC~vs~vehicle),
       title = sprintf("Cross-line reproducibility (top %d genes selected in BU6)", n_conc)) +
  theme_fig +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4))

p_conc

save_fig(p_conc, "Fig1D_line_concordance", 7, 3.9)
```

sample-sample correlation heat map 
```{r}
top_var <- names(sort(apply(expr_corr, 1, var), decreasing = TRUE))[1:n_var_genes]
cor_mat <- cor(expr_corr[top_var, ], method = "pearson")
hc      <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor_mat), method = "average")
ord     <- rownames(cor_mat)[hc$order]
 
cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
  mutate(s1 = rownames(.)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-s1, names_to = "s2", values_to = "r") %>%
  mutate(s1 = factor(s1, levels = ord), s2 = factor(s2, levels = rev(ord)))
 
## coloured annotation strip for treatment
annot <- meta %>% mutate(s1 = factor(sample, levels = ord))
 
p_cor <- ggplot(cor_long, aes(s1, s2, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_tile(data = annot, aes(x = s1, y = length(ord) + 1.2, fill = NULL,
                              colour = NULL), fill = group_cols[as.character(annot$label)],
            height = 1.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = median(cor_mat[upper.tri(cor_mat)]),
                       name = "Pearson r") +
  coord_equal(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Sample correlation (line effect removed)") +
  theme_fig +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
        axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())

p_cor

save_fig(p_cor, "Fig1E_sample_correlation", 5.2, 5)
```

Remaking hallmark fgsea plot from carlos so that it is ordered and themed correctly 
```{r}
## ---- 0. Setup ---------------------------------------------------------------
setwd("/restricted/projectnb/crem-trainees/Murphy_Lab/Elise/GeroScreen_Paper")
 
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(limma)
  library(fgsea)
})
 
logcpm_raw <- read.csv("26_01_29_logcpm.csv", check.names = FALSE,
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 
annot_cols  <- c("gene_key", "gene_id", "symbol", "feature_name",
                 "Length", "gene_biotype")
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(logcpm_raw), annot_cols)
 
out_dir <- "Fig1_fgsea"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
 
base_font <- "sans"
 
## If msigdbr can't be used on the SCC, download the Hallmark GMT
## (h.all.v*.Hs.symbols.gmt) from MSigDB into this folder and set its name here.
hallmark_gmt <- "h.all.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"
 
set.seed(2026)  # fgsea permutations
 
## ---- 1. Sample metadata -----------------------------------------------------
group_levels <- c("CTRL", "RUT", "SIT", "GEN", "EBS", "CAL", "PI", "TRA", "RAP")
full_names   <- c(CTRL = "Vehicle", RUT = "Rutin", SIT = "Sitagliptin",
                  GEN = "Genistein", EBS = "Ebselen", CAL = "Calpeptin",
                  PI = "PI-103", TRA = "Trametinib", RAP = "Rapamycin")
treatments   <- setdiff(group_levels, "CTRL")
 
meta <- data.frame(sample = sample_cols, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(line  = factor(sub("_.*$", "", sample)),
         cond  = sub("^[^_]+_", "", sample),
         group = factor(sub("[0-9]+$", "", cond), levels = group_levels))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(meta$group)))
 
group_cols <- setNames(c("grey55", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442",
                         "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "#000000"),
                       full_names[group_levels])
 
## ---- 2. Expression matrix (one row per gene symbol) ------------------------
expr_df <- logcpm_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(symbol), symbol != "") %>%
  mutate(row_mean = rowMeans(across(all_of(sample_cols)))) %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  slice_max(row_mean, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
 
expr <- as.matrix(expr_df[, meta$sample])
rownames(expr) <- expr_df$symbol
 
## ---- 3. Expected pathway effects (matches Table 1) ---------------------------
## direction: +1 = expected enrichment (NES > 0), -1 = expected depletion
expected <- tribble(
  ~treatment, ~pathway,                             ~direction,
  "RUT", "HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE",              -1,
  "RUT", "HALLMARK_REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES_PATHWAY",    -1,
  "RUT", "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB",            -1,
  "SIT", "HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING",            -1,
  "SIT", "HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE",              -1,
  "SIT", "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB",            -1,
  "GEN", "HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_EARLY",             1,
  "EBS", "HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION",           1,
  "EBS", "HALLMARK_REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES_PATHWAY",    -1,
  "EBS", "HALLMARK_UNFOLDED_PROTEIN_RESPONSE",          -1,
  "CAL", "HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION",  -1,
  "PI",  "HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING",                   -1,
  "PI",  "HALLMARK_PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING",            -1,
  "PI",  "HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS",                          -1,
  "TRA", "HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_UP",                  -1,
  "TRA", "HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V1",                     -1,
  "TRA", "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB",            -1,
  "RAP", "HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING",                   -1
)
 
## Readable labels, same wording as Table 1
pathway_labels <- c(
  HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE             = "Inflammatory response",
  HALLMARK_REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES_PATHWAY   = "Reactive oxygen species pathway",
  HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB           = "TNF\u03b1 signaling via NF-\u03baB",
  HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING           = "IL6\u2013JAK\u2013STAT3 signaling",
  HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_EARLY           = "Estrogen response (early)",
  HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION         = "Oxidative phosphorylation",
  HALLMARK_UNFOLDED_PROTEIN_RESPONSE         = "Unfolded protein response",
  HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION = "Epithelial\u2013mesenchymal transition",
  HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING                  = "mTORC1 signaling",
  HALLMARK_PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING           = "PI3K\u2013AKT\u2013mTOR signaling",
  HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS                         = "Apoptosis",
  HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_UP                 = "KRAS signaling",
  HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V1                    = "MYC targets"
)
 
## ---- 4. Hallmark gene sets ----------------------------------------------------
hallmark <- tryCatch({
  hs <- tryCatch(msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H"),
                 error = function(e)
                   msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H"))
  split(hs$gene_symbol, hs$gs_name)
}, error = function(e) {
  if (!file.exists(hallmark_gmt))
    stop("msigdbr unavailable and '", hallmark_gmt, "' not found. ",
         "Download the Hallmark GMT from MSigDB into the working directory.")
  message("Using local GMT: ", hallmark_gmt)
  gmtPathways(hallmark_gmt)
})
hallmark <- lapply(hallmark, unique)
stopifnot(all(expected$pathway %in% names(hallmark)))
 
## ---- 5. limma statistics used for ranking -----------------------------------
## Pooled: each treatment vs vehicle, blocked on line
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group + line, data = meta)
colnames(design) <- make.names(sub("^group", "", colnames(design)))
contr <- makeContrasts(contrasts = paste0(make.names(treatments), " - CTRL"),
                       levels = design)
colnames(contr) <- treatments
fit_pooled <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(lmFit(expr, design), contr),
                     trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)
 
## Per line: each treatment vs vehicle within BU6 and within BU8
meta$line_group <- factor(paste(meta$line, meta$group, sep = "_"))
design_l <- model.matrix(~ 0 + line_group, data = meta)
colnames(design_l) <- sub("^line_group", "", colnames(design_l))
line_contrasts <- unlist(lapply(levels(meta$line), function(l)
  paste0(l, "_", treatments, " - ", l, "_CTRL")))
contr_l <- makeContrasts(contrasts = line_contrasts, levels = design_l)
colnames(contr_l) <- sub(" - .*$", "", line_contrasts)
fit_line <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(lmFit(expr, design_l), contr_l),
                   trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)
 
## Ranked lists: moderated t for every treatment x column
rank_list <- list()
for (tx in treatments) {
  rank_list[[paste0(tx, "|BU6")]]    <- fit_line$t[, paste0("BU6_", tx)]
  rank_list[[paste0(tx, "|BU8")]]    <- fit_line$t[, paste0("BU8_", tx)]
  rank_list[[paste0(tx, "|Pooled")]] <- fit_pooled$t[, tx]
}
 
## ---- 6. fGSEA -------------------------------------------------------------------
## All 50 Hallmark sets per contrast, so padj is corrected across the full
## Hallmark collection (not only the plotted sets).
fgsea_all <- bind_rows(lapply(names(rank_list), function(nm) {
  stats <- sort(rank_list[[nm]], decreasing = TRUE)
  res <- fgsea(pathways = hallmark, stats = stats, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500)
  parts <- strsplit(nm, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  as.data.frame(res) %>%
    select(pathway, NES, pval, padj, size) %>%
    mutate(treatment = parts[1], column = parts[2])
}))
write.csv(fgsea_all, file.path(out_dir, "fgsea_all_hallmarks.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
 
## ---- 7. Expected-pathway results --------------------------------------------
col_levels <- c("BU6", "BU8", "Pooled")
 
plot_df <- expected %>%
  left_join(fgsea_all, by = c("treatment", "pathway")) %>%
  mutate(concordant = sign(NES) == direction,
         shape_lab  = ifelse(concordant, "Concordant", "Discordant"),
         sig        = padj < 0.05,
         neglog_p   = -log10(padj),
         compound   = factor(full_names[treatment], levels = full_names[treatments]),
         pathway_lab = paste0(ifelse(direction > 0, "\u2191 ", "\u2193 "),
                              pathway_labels[pathway]),
         column     = factor(column, levels = col_levels))
 
## Row order within each compound follows the expected table. The y key is
## unique per compound (e.g. "RUT|..."), so shared pathway names like TNFa
## keep the Table 1 order in every panel; the prefix is stripped for display.
row_keys <- rev(paste(expected$treatment, expected$pathway, sep = "|"))
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(row_key = factor(paste(treatment, pathway, sep = "|"), levels = row_keys))
key_to_label <- setNames(as.character(plot_df$pathway_lab), as.character(plot_df$row_key))
 
write.csv(plot_df %>%
            select(treatment, compound, pathway, direction, column,
                   NES, pval, padj, size, concordant),
          file.path(out_dir, "fgsea_expected_pathways.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
 
## ---- 8. Figure ------------------------------------------------------------------
nes_lim <- ceiling(max(abs(plot_df$NES), na.rm = TRUE) * 2) / 2
 
theme_fig <- theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = base_font) +
  theme(axis.text          = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.line          = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y       = element_blank(),
        panel.border       = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4),
        panel.grid.major   = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
        strip.placement    = "outside",
        strip.background.y = element_rect(colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4),
        strip.text.y.left  = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold",
                                          margin = margin(0, 5, 0, 5)),
        strip.switch.pad.grid = unit(3, "pt"),
        panel.spacing.y    = unit(3, "pt"),
        legend.key.size    = unit(0.35, "cm"),
        plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        plot.title.position = "plot")
 
p_fgsea <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(column, row_key)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = neglog_p, fill = NES, shape = shape_lab,
                 stroke = ifelse(sig, 0.8, 0.3),
                 colour = ifelse(sig, "black", "grey45"))) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Concordant = 21, Discordant = 24),
                     name = "Expected direction") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-nes_lim, nes_lim), name = "NES") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 6), breaks = c(1, 2, 5, 10),
                        limits = c(0, NA), name = expression(-log[10]~adj.~p)) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(k) key_to_label[k]) +
  facet_grid(compound ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Hallmark fGSEA: validation of expected drug activity",
       subtitle = "Arrow = predicted direction; black outline = adj. p < 0.05") +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, fill = "grey80")),
         size  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, fill = "grey80"))) +
  theme_fig
 
## Fill each compound's strip box with its colour. ggplot can't colour strips
## individually, so the strips are recoloured after the plot is built.
## The helper searches each strip for its background rectangle and label text,
## so it works regardless of how a given ggplot2 version nests the strip.
## Black text on light colours, white text on dark colours.
light_bg <- c("Rutin", "Sitagliptin", "Genistein", "Ebselen", "Trametinib")
 
recolour_strip <- function(grob, fill, text_col) {
  if (inherits(grob, "rect")) {
    gp <- if (is.null(grob$gp)) grid::gpar() else grob$gp
    gp$fill <- fill
    grob$gp <- gp
  } else if (inherits(grob, "text")) {
    gp <- if (is.null(grob$gp)) grid::gpar() else grob$gp
    gp$col <- text_col
    grob$gp <- gp
  }
  if (!is.null(grob$grobs))
    grob$grobs <- lapply(grob$grobs, recolour_strip, fill = fill, text_col = text_col)
  if (!is.null(grob$children)) {
    for (nm in seq_along(grob$children))
      grob$children[[nm]] <- recolour_strip(grob$children[[nm]],
                                            fill = fill, text_col = text_col)
  }
  grob
}
 
## Build the grob on a cairo device (the same one used for saving) so label
## widths with the arrows and Greek letters are measured correctly
cairo_pdf(tmp_pdf <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf"), width = 7, height = 6.5)
g <- ggplotGrob(p_fgsea)
invisible(dev.off()); unlink(tmp_pdf)
 
strip_idx <- grep("^strip-l", g$layout$name)
strip_idx <- strip_idx[order(g$layout$t[strip_idx])]          # top to bottom
compounds_in_order <- levels(droplevels(plot_df$compound))
stopifnot(length(strip_idx) == length(compounds_in_order))
 
for (k in seq_along(strip_idx)) {
  cmp <- compounds_in_order[k]
  g$grobs[[strip_idx[k]]] <- recolour_strip(
    g$grobs[[strip_idx[k]]],
    fill     = unname(group_cols[cmp]),
    text_col = if (cmp %in% light_bg) "black" else "white")
}
 
## To view in RStudio, draw the recoloured grob (printing p_fgsea shows the
## plain, uncoloured version)
if (interactive()) {
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(g)
}
 
## Save the recoloured grob directly with grid (ggsave can refuse objects that
## aren't ggplots in newer ggplot2 versions). Cairo for both, so text is sized
## exactly as measured above. A plain, uncoloured backup is saved if the
## coloured version fails for any reason.
save_grob <- function(grob, name, w, h) {
  png(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), width = w, height = h,
      units = "in", res = 600, type = "cairo")
  grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(grob)
  invisible(dev.off())
  cairo_pdf(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), width = w, height = h)
  grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(grob)
  invisible(dev.off())
}
 
tryCatch({
  save_grob(g, "Fig1_fgsea_validation", 7, 6.5)
  message("Saved: ", file.path(out_dir, "Fig1_fgsea_validation.png/.pdf"))
}, error = function(e) {
  while (dev.cur() > 1) dev.off()
  message("Coloured version failed (", conditionMessage(e),
          "); saving uncoloured version instead.")
  save_grob(ggplotGrob(p_fgsea), "Fig1_fgsea_validation_uncoloured", 7, 6.5)
})
```

making a small figure to explore tramatenib more 

```{r}
## ---- 0. Setup ---------------------------------------------------------------
setwd("/restricted/projectnb/crem-trainees/Murphy_Lab/Elise/GeroScreen_Paper")
 
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(limma)
  library(fgsea)
})
 
logcpm_raw <- read.csv("26_01_29_logcpm.csv", check.names = FALSE,
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 
annot_cols  <- c("gene_key", "gene_id", "symbol", "feature_name",
                 "Length", "gene_biotype")
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(logcpm_raw), annot_cols)
 
out_dir <- "Fig1_trametinib"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
 
base_font <- "sans"
fdr_cut   <- 0.05
tra_col   <- "#CC79A7"                          # trametinib colour in all panels
up_col    <- "#B2182B"; down_col <- "#2166AC"   # same up/down colours as DEG panel
 
## Hallmark GMT fallback if msigdbr can't be used (see fgsea script)
hallmark_gmt <- "h.all.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"
set.seed(2026)
 
## ---- 1. Sample metadata and expression (one row per gene symbol) -------------
group_levels <- c("CTRL", "RUT", "SIT", "GEN", "EBS", "CAL", "PI", "TRA", "RAP")
 
meta <- data.frame(sample = sample_cols, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(line  = factor(sub("_.*$", "", sample)),
         group = factor(sub("[0-9]+$", "", sub("^[^_]+_", "", sample)),
                        levels = group_levels))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(meta$group)))
 
expr_df <- logcpm_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(symbol), symbol != "") %>%
  mutate(row_mean = rowMeans(across(all_of(sample_cols)))) %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  slice_max(row_mean, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
expr <- as.matrix(expr_df[, meta$sample])
rownames(expr) <- expr_df$symbol
 
## ---- 2. Trametinib vs vehicle (same pooled limma model as other panels) -----
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group + line, data = meta)
colnames(design) <- make.names(sub("^group", "", colnames(design)))
contr <- makeContrasts(TRA = TRA - CTRL, levels = design)
fit_tra <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(lmFit(expr, design), contr),
                  trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)
 
tra_de <- topTable(fit_tra, coef = "TRA", number = Inf, sort.by = "none") %>%
  mutate(gene = rownames(.),
         status = case_when(adj.P.Val < fdr_cut & logFC > 0 ~ "Up",
                            adj.P.Val < fdr_cut & logFC < 0 ~ "Down",
                            TRUE ~ "NS"))
write.csv(tra_de, file.path(out_dir, "TRA_limma_vs_vehicle.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
 
## MEK-ERK transcriptional targets (MPAS genes; Wagle et al. 2018)
mpas_genes <- c("PHLDA1", "SPRY2", "SPRY4", "DUSP4", "DUSP6",
                "CCND1", "EPHA2", "EPHA4", "ETV4", "ETV5")
 
## ---- 3. Hallmark fGSEA for trametinib -----------------------------------------
hallmark <- tryCatch({
  hs <- tryCatch(msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H"),
                 error = function(e)
                   msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H"))
  split(hs$gene_symbol, hs$gs_name)
}, error = function(e) {
  if (!file.exists(hallmark_gmt))
    stop("msigdbr unavailable and '", hallmark_gmt, "' not found.")
  gmtPathways(hallmark_gmt)
})
hallmark <- lapply(hallmark, unique)
 
tra_stats <- sort(setNames(tra_de$t, tra_de$gene), decreasing = TRUE)
tra_gsea  <- as.data.frame(fgsea(hallmark, tra_stats, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500)) %>%
  select(pathway, NES, pval, padj, size) %>%
  arrange(desc(NES))
write.csv(tra_gsea, file.path(out_dir, "TRA_fgsea_hallmark.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
 
## Tidy Hallmark names: "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB" -> "TNFa signaling via NF-kB"
clean_hallmark <- function(x) {
  x <- sub("^HALLMARK_", "", x)
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x <- tolower(x)
  fixes <- c("tnfa" = "TNF\u03b1", "nfkb" = "NF-\u03baB", "kras" = "KRAS",
             "myc" = "MYC", "mtorc1" = "mTORC1", "pi3k akt mtor" = "PI3K\u2013AKT\u2013mTOR",
             "il6 jak stat3" = "IL6\u2013JAK\u2013STAT3", "il2 stat5" = "IL2\u2013STAT5",
             "e2f" = "E2F", "g2m" = "G2M", "dna" = "DNA", "uv" = "UV",
             "tgf beta" = "TGF-\u03b2", "wnt beta catenin" = "WNT/\u03b2-catenin",
             "kras signaling up" = "KRAS signaling (up)",
             "kras signaling dn" = "KRAS signaling (down)",
             "interferon alpha" = "IFN-\u03b1", "interferon gamma" = "IFN-\u03b3",
             "p53" = "p53", "tnfa signaling via nfkb" = "TNF\u03b1 signaling via NF-\u03baB",
             "epithelial mesenchymal transition" = "Epithelial\u2013mesenchymal transition",
             "unfolded protein response" = "Unfolded protein response")
  for (k in names(fixes)[order(-nchar(names(fixes)))])
    x <- sub(paste0("^", k, "$"), fixes[[k]], x)
  x <- gsub("\\bil2 stat5\\b", "IL2\u2013STAT5", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\\bil6 jak stat3\\b", "IL6\u2013JAK\u2013STAT3", x, perl = TRUE)
  for (k in c("tnfa", "nfkb", "kras", "myc", "mtorc1", "e2f", "g2m", "dna", "uv"))
    x <- gsub(paste0("\\b", k, "\\b"), fixes[[k]], x, perl = TRUE)
  paste0(toupper(substr(x, 1, 1)), substr(x, 2, nchar(x)))
}
 
## ---- 4. Shared theme (matches panels b-d) -------------------------------------
theme_fig <- theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = base_font) +
  theme(axis.text        = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.line        = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
        axis.ticks       = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
        legend.key.size  = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.title.position = "plot")
 
## ---- 5. Panel e: volcano with MEK-ERK targets labelled ------------------------
n_up   <- sum(tra_de$status == "Up")
n_down <- sum(tra_de$status == "Down")
lab_df <- tra_de %>% filter(gene %in% mpas_genes)
 
p_volcano <- ggplot(tra_de, aes(logFC, -log10(P.Value))) +
  geom_point(data = filter(tra_de, status == "NS"),
             colour = "grey80", size = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = filter(tra_de, status != "NS"),
             aes(colour = status), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = lab_df, shape = 21, fill = tra_col, colour = "black",
             size = 1.8, stroke = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Up = up_col, Down = down_col), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = expression(log[2]*FC~(trametinib~vs~vehicle)),
       y = expression(-log[10]~p),
       title = "Trametinib vs vehicle",
       subtitle = sprintf("%d down, %d up (FDR < %.2f)\nMEK\u2013ERK target genes labelled",
                          n_down, n_up, fdr_cut)) +
  theme_fig
 
if (requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) {
  p_volcano <- p_volcano +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = lab_df, aes(label = gene), size = 2.4,
                             family = base_font, fontface = "italic",
                             min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.25,
                             box.padding = 0.3, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1)
} else {
  p_volcano <- p_volcano +
    geom_text(data = lab_df, aes(label = gene), size = 2.4, vjust = -0.8,
              family = base_font, fontface = "italic")
}
 
## ---- 6. Panel f: top Hallmark pathways --------------------------------------------
n_show <- 5   # pathways shown in each direction
nes_df <- bind_rows(
  tra_gsea %>% filter(padj < fdr_cut, NES > 0) %>% slice_max(NES, n = n_show),
  tra_gsea %>% filter(padj < fdr_cut, NES < 0) %>% slice_min(NES, n = n_show)
) %>%
  mutate(label = clean_hallmark(pathway),
         label = factor(label, levels = label[order(NES)]),
         dir   = ifelse(NES > 0, "Up", "Down"))
 
p_nes <- ggplot(nes_df, aes(NES, label, fill = dir)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Up = up_col, Down = down_col), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "NES", y = NULL, title = "Top Hallmark pathways") +
  theme_fig +
  theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
 
## ---- 7. Save (cairo for PNG and PDF) ---------------------------------------------
save_fig <- function(p, name, w, h) {
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h,
         units = "in", dpi = 600, device = png, type = "cairo")
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), p, width = w, height = h,
         units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
}
save_fig(p_volcano, "Fig1e_TRA_volcano",      2.6, 2.4)
save_fig(p_nes,     "Fig1f_TRA_hallmark_NES", 2.8, 2.4)
 
if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(patchwork)
  p_combined <- p_volcano + p_nes + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1))
  save_fig(p_combined, "Fig1ef_TRA_combined", 5.4, 2.4)
}
```

making volcano plots of each compound for supplementary figure 
```{r}
setwd("/restricted/projectnb/crem-trainees/Murphy_Lab/Elise/GeroScreen_Paper")
 
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(limma)
})
 
logcpm_raw <- read.csv("26_01_29_logcpm.csv", check.names = FALSE,
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 
annot_cols  <- c("gene_key", "gene_id", "symbol", "feature_name",
                 "Length", "gene_biotype")
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(logcpm_raw), annot_cols)
 
out_dir <- "FigS_volcanoes"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
 
base_font <- "sans"
fdr_cut   <- 0.05
up_col    <- "#B2182B"; down_col <- "#2166AC"   # same as DEG panel and Fig 1e
n_label   <- 3       # top significant genes labelled in each direction per panel
same_axes <- TRUE    # TRUE = identical axes in every panel (effect sizes comparable)
                     # FALSE = each panel scaled to its own data
group_levels <- c("CTRL", "RUT", "SIT", "GEN", "EBS", "CAL", "PI", "TRA", "RAP")
full_names   <- c(RUT = "Rutin", SIT = "Sitagliptin", GEN = "Genistein",
                  EBS = "Ebselen", CAL = "Calpeptin", PI = "PI-103",
                  TRA = "Trametinib", RAP = "Rapamycin")
treatments   <- setdiff(group_levels, "CTRL")
 
meta <- data.frame(sample = sample_cols, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(line  = factor(sub("_.*$", "", sample)),
         group = factor(sub("[0-9]+$", "", sub("^[^_]+_", "", sample)),
                        levels = group_levels))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(meta$group)))
 
expr_df <- logcpm_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(symbol), symbol != "") %>%
  mutate(row_mean = rowMeans(across(all_of(sample_cols)))) %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  slice_max(row_mean, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
expr <- as.matrix(expr_df[, meta$sample])
rownames(expr) <- expr_df$symbol
## ---- 2. limma: each compound vs vehicle, blocked on line ----------------------
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group + line, data = meta)
colnames(design) <- make.names(sub("^group", "", colnames(design)))
contr <- makeContrasts(contrasts = paste0(make.names(treatments), " - CTRL"),
                       levels = design)
colnames(contr) <- treatments
fit <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(lmFit(expr, design), contr), trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)
 
de_all <- bind_rows(lapply(treatments, function(tx) {
  topTable(fit, coef = tx, number = Inf, sort.by = "none") %>%
    mutate(gene = rownames(.), treatment = tx)
})) %>%
  mutate(compound = factor(full_names[treatment], levels = full_names[treatments]),
         status   = case_when(adj.P.Val < fdr_cut & logFC > 0 ~ "Up",
                              adj.P.Val < fdr_cut & logFC < 0 ~ "Down",
                              TRUE ~ "NS"),
         neglog_p = -log10(P.Value))
write.csv(de_all %>% select(compound, gene, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, status),
          file.path(out_dir, "limma_all_compounds_vs_vehicle.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
 
## ---- 3. Labels and DEG counts per panel -----------------------------------------
lab_df <- de_all %>%
  filter(status != "NS") %>%
  group_by(compound, status) %>%
  slice_min(P.Value, n = n_label, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
 
count_df <- de_all %>%
  group_by(compound) %>%
  summarise(n_up = sum(status == "Up"), n_down = sum(status == "Down"),
            .groups = "drop")
 
## ---- 4. Plot ----------------------------------------------------------------------
theme_fig <- theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = base_font) +
  theme(axis.text        = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.line        = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
        axis.ticks       = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
        panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
        panel.spacing    = unit(6, "pt"),
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.title.position = "plot")
 
p_volc <- ggplot(de_all, aes(logFC, neglog_p)) +
  geom_point(data = filter(de_all, status == "NS"),
             colour = "grey80", size = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = filter(de_all, status != "NS"),
             aes(colour = status), size = 0.4, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = count_df, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0(n_down, " down")),
            hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 2.3, colour = down_col,
            family = base_font, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = count_df, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0(n_up, " up")),
            hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 2.3, colour = up_col,
            family = base_font, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ compound, nrow = 4, ncol = 2,
             scales = if (same_axes) "fixed" else "free") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Up = up_col, Down = down_col), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = expression(log[2]*FC~vs~vehicle), y = expression(-log[10]~p),
       title = "Differential expression for each compound vs vehicle",
       subtitle = sprintf("limma, blocked on cell line; coloured = FDR < %.2f; top %d genes per direction labelled",
                          fdr_cut, n_label)) +
  theme_fig
 
if (requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) {
  p_volc <- p_volc +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = lab_df, aes(label = gene), size = 2,
                             family = base_font, fontface = "italic",
                             min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2,
                             box.padding = 0.25, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1)
} else {
  p_volc <- p_volc +
    geom_text(data = lab_df, aes(label = gene), size = 2, vjust = -0.7,
              family = base_font, fontface = "italic")
}
 
## ---- 5. Save (cairo for PNG and PDF) ---------------------------------------------
save_fig <- function(p, name, w, h) {
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h,
         units = "in", dpi = 600, device = png, type = "cairo")
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), p, width = w, height = h,
         units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
}
save_fig(p_volc, "FigS_volcanoes_all_compounds", 5.5, 8.5)
 
## ---- 6. Session info ----------------------------------------------------------
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(out_dir, "sessionInfo.txt"))
message("Done. Outputs written to: ", normalizePath(out_dir))
```
